verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench is a set of software tools (Document Driver, calculators), so programmatic event subscriptions are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack does not document any webhooks or outbound event callbacks. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, which suggests there is no developer-facing integration surface at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
